title: First player-confirmed playable generated map
assessment_source: Project owner, expert-player in-game assessment, 25 October 2026
assessment: This map is actually playable. Not good, but also not terribly bad and IS playable.
meaning: A saved map produced by the staged learned-terrain, learned-marker and learned-reclaim-allocation pipeline loads and is judged playable by the player. First playable proof of concept, not competitive certification or evidence that every generated map is playable.
limits: Balance and competitive quality unproven; known resource and terrain limitations remain.
Starts are supplied; symmetry, finishing, peak decoding, prop instantiation and budgets are deterministic tooling.
Textures are inherited stock materials, not learned painting.
This map contains natural trees and rocks, not the later unverified wreck pilot.
No generation, training or cross-machine seed reproduction is needed to play this frozen artifact.
next_work: Further research and training-data improvements; preserve this demo and do not automatically launch training.
